api.label: API extractor
api.tip: Custom REST or OData extractor for cloud applications and bespoke systems. Set the interval to 0 for real-time pull with change events.

delta.label: Delta Sharing
delta.tip: Reads live data straight from the source platform (Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Jira and others) without copying it.

event.label: Event / Ingestion API
event.tip: The source pushes events straight into the Circularity ingestion API, or drops them in cloud storage such as AWS S3. Events are de-duplicated and ordered.

file.label: Flat file upload
file.sub: CSV, Parquet, JSON or ZIP, up to 1 GB
file.tip: Manual or static import of CSV, Parquet, JSON or ZIP files, capped at 1 GB per file. Supports evaluation, not live automation.

jdbc.label: JDBC extractor
jdbc.tip: Standard relational database connection using a JDBC/SQL driver, direct or through an on-premise uplink server.

native.label: Native connector
native.tip: Pre-built extractor for major enterprise systems such as SAP ECC, S/4HANA and Oracle EBS. Runs on a schedule or as an automated delta pull.
